name: @mazurovn/mazzy-vpn-pi
description: Mazzy VPN extension for pi — connect to and manage Mazzy VPN from inside pi: auto-connect, live status widget, monitor + auto-reconnect, and LLM-callable tools to connect/switch/disconnect/recover/verify (bypass blocks). Drives the mazzy-vpn Go CLI.
